newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Dubai-based trader swaps $156 million in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Dubai-based trader swaps $156 million in Pakistan.

text.p: Dubai-based foreign exchange dealer Abdul Razzak said on Sunday he had swapped $156 million for the Pakistani rupees on a no-interest basis for seven years in November.
"The dollar amount has been deposited with the State (central) Bank of Pakistan and I have taken equivalent of that amount in rupees for seven years," he told Reuters by telephone.
"The bank will not pay interest on the dollars to me and I will not pay interest on the rupees to the bank," Razzak said.
Central bank officials have not confirmed the deal.
